newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to host wheat conference November 25-26.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to host wheat conference November 25-26.

text.p: Brazil's Wheat Industry Association is organising an international wheat conference on November 25-26 to be attended by more than 400 industry officials and executives, it said in a statement.

The conference - the 4th International Wheat Seminar - will discuss domestic production, consumption, prices and financing and will be opened by Brazil's Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles.
Argentina's Agricultural Secretary Felipe Sola will accompany Dornelles at the opening ceremony, the statement said.
As well as representatives from the U.S., participants will be coming from throughout the Mercosul region, Canada and various European countries.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
